data.title: Freehold Royalties Declares Dividend for September 2026
data.description: In Calgary, Alberta on September 15, 2026, Freehold Royalties Ltd. issued a statement that its Board of Directors has approved a dividend of Cdn. $0.09 per common share. This dividend is scheduled to be paid on October 15, 2026, to shareholders who are recorded as of September 29, 2026. This dividend announcement was made by Freehold Royalties Ltd. (TSX: FRU).

data.title: Credit Acceptance Announces Extension of Revolving Secured Warehouse Facility and Extension of $500.0 Million Asset-Backed Financing
data.description: In Southfield, Michigan, on September 15, 2026, Credit Acceptance Corporation (Nasdaq: CACC) revealed that they have extended the revolving secured warehouse facility's closure date from September 20, 2027, to September 15, 2028. The facility amounts to $500.0 million. The interest rate for borrowing under this facility has been lowered from the Secured Overnight Financing Rate (“SOFR”) plus 185 basis points to SOFR plus 175 basis points.

data.title: Binance stops $4.6B losses with AI in real-time risk ops, detecting fraud in 80% of workflows.
data.description: Binance, a leading cryptocurrency exchange, has successfully utilized artificial intelligence to prevent a staggering $4.6 billion in potential user losses. This impressive feat highlights the platform's adoption of advanced fraud detection techniques, which are operational across 80% of its risk workflows. This strategic use of AI underscores Binance's commitment to safeguarding user assets and enhancing security measures within the crypto space.

data.title: Dense and MoE models compared for AI development, offering insights on simplicity, scalability, performance, and memory trade-offs.
data.description: Comparing dense models to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models in the realm of AI reveals a crucial decision between emphasizing simplicity or scalability. Insights gained highlight the impact on performance and memory trade-offs. Key considerations include the balance between model complexity and computational efficiency, with MoE models showing promise in achieving higher accuracy levels but at the cost of increased memory usage. Evaluating when to prioritize either approach involves weighing the pros and cons found in performance metrics and resource consumption, ultimately influencing the decision-making process in AI development.

data.title: NVIDIA's DSX platform enhances AI factory efficiency, achieving 24% more tokens within fixed power budgets, transforming industrial AI.
data.description: NVIDIA's DSX platform is revolutionizing AI operations in factories by boosting efficiency. It has successfully increased token throughput by 24% within set power limits, paving the way for a new era in industrial AI.

data.title: NVIDIA reveals AI factory gains at AI Infra Summit, credits Vera Rubin for improving energy efficiency and token production.
data.description: At the AI Infra Summit, NVIDIA showcased significant advancements in artificial intelligence within factories. They emphasized Vera Rubin's contributions in enhancing energy efficiency and token production. This unveiling is crucial in revolutionizing the industry and increasing productivity.

data.title: NVLink 6 by NVIDIA enhances AI factory resilience via multi-layer strategy, ensuring flawless performance at large scales.
data.description: NVIDIA NVLink 6 has implemented a new feature that provides multi-layer resiliency for AI factories. This advancement allows for uninterrupted performance and consistent uptime on a large scale, ensuring no loss in efficiency.

data.title: Groq 3 LPX by NVIDIA increases AI efficiency with deterministic execution, reducing power requirements and improving real-time inference.
data.description: The Groq 3 LPX accelerators from NVIDIA have been designed to improve AI efficiency through deterministic execution, which reduces power consumption while increasing real-time inference performance. This advancement is crucial as it enhances the speed and accuracy of AI processes. The technology significantly lowers energy needs by an estimated 30% compared to traditional methods, making it a more environmentally friendly option. In addition, the accelerators improve real-time inference capabilities by up to 40%, demonstrating a substantial leap in AI processing speed. Overall, this innovation by NVIDIA is set to revolutionize the industry by offering faster, more precise, and energy-efficient AI solutions.

data.title: Allconnect™ Earns Its Highest ACSI® Score in Company History, Delivering Eight Straight Years of Industry-Leading Customer Experience
data.description: In Fort Mill, South Carolina, Allconnect, a prominent consumer platform aiding customers in comparing and accessing home services, achieved a record-high 2025 American Customer Satisfaction Index (ACSI®) score of 89. This marks the highest score in the company's history, surpassing that of over 450 companies reported across 43 industries in 2025. Allconnect's 89 rating concludes an impressive eight-year streak during which it consistently outperformed or equaled the highest ACSI score.
